targets.title: How Economic Conditions Changed the Number of US Farms, 1960-88.
targets.evidence_quote: We begin our analysis by replicating the results from Gale (1990). We use the same regression models and time periods and attempt to match the data sources as close as possible.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: The largest difference in the replication analysis is the coefficients of the ratio of nonfarm earnings to real farm income. This difference probably stems from the construction of the variable and the sources used.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Reconstructed historical data yield substantively different coefficients, including loss of significance for the price ratio. Extensions add years, farm categories and countries; these do not establish robustness on the original data alone.

reasoning: Re-analysis reconstructs the original historical sample and regression, rather than collecting a new participant sample.
